std_narrative.citation:
The family of Joseph Duclos, son of Joseph Duclos and Louise Fortier, and Genevieve Carrier, daughter of Jean Baptiste Carrier and Marie Anne Poire, includes at least three children. Joseph and Genevieve were married on 29 October 1816 in Lauzon (St-Joseph-de-la-Pointe-Lévy). Their children are: * Joseph, born 18 February 1819, Lauzon, died 7 May 1819, Lauzon * Genevieve, born 2 June 1821, Lauzon, married to Philippe Morin on 6 September 1853, Lévis * Caroline, born 26 April 1827, Lauzon.
